description: Pinned source commits for the Roblox Brain knowledge system. Every knowledge artifact produced downstream must reference one of these commits so an answer can be traced to an exact version and a refresh can be expressed as a diff between two known points.

policy.note: Commits are recorded verbatim from Step 2 and are NOT resolved forward to branch tips. Advancing a pin is a deliberate, reviewed action.

repositories.name: creator-docs
repositories.commit_subject: update Open Source Docs from Roblox internal teams

license.note: Content is CC BY 4.0 and REQUIRES attribution. Any surfaced text must carry it.

lfs.rationale: A normal clone reaches 8.6 GB because LFS pulls every image and video. Step 1 classified all binary media as never-ingest, so blobs are intentionally excluded. Result: 66 MB with the full ~21 MB text corpus intact.
lfs.consequence: Media files in this working tree are LFS pointer stubs, NOT real binaries. Tooling must not assume a .png here is an image.
lfs.recovery: git lfs pull --include='<path>' for specific assets if a later feature requires them.
